block_size.description: Block size as a multiple of 512 bytes (default 20 for 10kB).

clean.description: Shortcut for clean_meta, clean_print, and clean_space.

clean_meta.description: Replace shell meta characters in filenames with hyphens.

clean_print.description: Replace non-printable ASCII characters in filenames with hyphens.

clean_space.description: Replace white space characters in filenames with hyphens.

down_case.description: Force file names to be all lower case.

excludes.description: List of shell filename patterns to exclude from the archive. Items are strings representing the pattern.

extract.description: Extract the contents of the archive.

group_name.description: Set the group name field in headers. Empty string to omit.

group_number.description: Set the group number field in headers. 0 to omit.

infile.description: Input file path. Use '-' for stdin.

input_format.description: Force input format (e.g., 'tar', 'cpio', 'ar'). Empty string to auto-detect.

list.description: List file headers to standard error.

mode_clear.description: Octal bits to clear in file modes (e.g., '0022').

mode_set.description: Octal bits to set in file modes (e.g., '0755').

now.description: Set last-modified time to current time for all files.

old_type.description: Keep old normal file type indicators unaltered.

outfile.description: Output file path. Use '-' for stdout.

output_format.description: Force output format (e.g., 'tar', 'cpio', 'ar'). Empty string to match input.

prefix.description: Prefix to add to filenames. Empty string to omit.

remove_prefixes.description: List of directory prefixes to remove from filenames. Items are strings.

up_case.description: Force file names to be all upper case.

user_name.description: Set the user name field in headers. Empty string to omit.

user_number.description: Set the user number field in headers. 0 to omit.
